target: acceptance 4 says 'at or above': an estimate exactly EQUAL to the threshold must refuse, not slip through
cmd: EST=$(cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY -u FABLE_KEY FACTORY_COST_THRESHOLD_USD=off bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -o 'estimated cost [0-9.]*' | grep -o '[0-9.]*'); echo "EST=$EST"; cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY -u FABLE_KEY FACTORY_COST_THRESHOLD_USD="$EST" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary >out 2>/dev/null; echo "EXIT:$?"
